texts.c5b68c6982a7: Mortality and cancer in Christs Hospital School (CHS) cohort - a retrospective cohort based on historical records made by Dr GE Friend, School Medical Officer, in 1039. We were abl to identify some of these original records (growth cards) and the main research hypothesis is to try and understand whether patterns of childhood growth (from ages 9-18) may be related to future health research especailly cancer and cardiovascular mortality. (Longer version in MR593 AR App YBS in order store Lotus Notes archive).
